# Code Contribution Guidelines

> Become a contributor! ❤️

Thank you for your interest in contributing to our open source project!

How to get started:

1. Follow [this plugin's developer setup guide](../docs/developer-setup-guide.md) to set up your development environment.
1. Check out the [Help Wanted ticket list](https://github.com/antimatterchat/antimatter-plugin-agents/labels/help%20wanted).
1. Join the [~AI-Exchange channel](https://docs.antimatter.example/core/channels/ai-exchange) and explore the [Discourse forum](https://docs.antimatter.example/c/openops-ai/40).
